plan_a:
Cephalid Breakfast combo: pair Cephalid Illusionist with a free-untap targeting outlet (Nomads en-Kor or a Shuko equipped on the Illusionist) to self-mill the entire library. The dumped Narcomoebas hit the battlefield, then flash back Dread Return (sacrificing three creatures) to reanimate a payoff, or resolve Thassa's Oracle with an empty library to win. The mill loop is fired at instant speed by repeatedly targeting the Illusionist with the en-Kor/Shuko ability, so the decision signal is stack-heavy: how many activations to point before milling too far, when to hold priority, and sequencing Dread Return vs Oracle. Set up and protect with Brainstorm, Ponder, Force of Will, and Swords to Plowshares; Orim's Chant / Cabal Therapy buy a clean turn. Karakas and Urza's Saga give resilience and a plan B. Go off when the loop and payoff are protected.
